zh: 原创潮玩角色，一颗暖浆短绒圆核和一盏正在慢转的豆浆石磨长在一起：整只石磨就是它的身体，拿掉磨就没有角色。横宽的深石灰岩双层圆盘围成胸腹，上扇只错开一指宽，盘沿有一圈浅浆，没有泼溅，盘下两枚短钝足。磨心是一颗暖浆圆核小头，几乎没有颈，半垂小黑豆眼，极小一字嘴，视线低垂。双足左右分开站稳，微微侧过身，像还在转，却不必转满。主体是暖浆短绒，只有磨盘是粗质深石灰岩面，盘沿有一点红。配色是暖浆白配深石灰，加一点红。单个角色完整全身，正面略侧，站在浅灰纯色背景前，柔和棚拍光，像真实的搪胶毛绒或手办产品照。不要儿童绘本或涂色书风格，不要卡通吉祥物，不要闪亮的动漫大眼，不要穿衣服的人类小孩造型，不要奔跑、跳跃或任何动作场景，不要速度线，不要细长的橡皮管式手脚，不要细长的手指，不要张嘴大笑，不要多余的饰品和细节，不要背景物件。不要真人脸发型服装，不要明星姓名，不要现有潮玩或品牌名，不要疾病、伤口或残缺造型，不要整体透明果冻身体。不要编制证件或高考试卷，不要锁链或被夹痛的造型，不要可阅读的文字和数字，不要发光屏幕里的节目画面。不要泼溅的浆，不要被压扁的造型。
enp: Original designer toy character: a warm-soy-milk plush rounded core fused with a slowly turning stone mill — the mill is the body, without it there is no character. A wide dark-limestone double disc forms the torso, the upper stone shifts only a finger's width, a thin ring of slurry sits on the rim, no splash, two short blunt feet below. A warm rounded head sits in the mill eye, almost no neck, half-lidded tiny black bean eyes, a tiny straight mouth, gaze lowered. Feet planted apart, standing still and slightly turned, as if it is still turning and need not finish all at once. Body is warm-soy plush; only the mill is rough dark limestone; a small red accent sits on the rim. Colors: warm soy-white with dark limestone and a red accent. Single character, full body, slight three-quarter front view, standing on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, looks like a real vinyl-plush or figure product photo. No children's book or coloring page style, no cartoon mascot, no big shiny anime eyes, no clothed human child figure, no running, jumping or action scene, no speed lines, no thin rubber-hose limbs, no thin long fingers, no wide open-mouth grin, no extra accessories or details, no background props. No real person's face, hairstyle or clothing, no celebrity names, no existing toy or brand names, no disease, wounds or disfigurement, no fully transparent jelly body. No official appointment papers or exam sheets, no chains or a form that pinches, no readable letters or numerals, no TV program playing on a lit screen. No splashing slurry, no crushed or flattened form.
